blocks.x: Vacation rental services like Vrbo have completely altered how people experience new destinations, opening the doors to lesser-known towns and neighborhoods where hotels are scarce and allowing travelers to better immerse themselves in the everyday lives of the communities they visit. In today’s economy, though, rental listings can be just as expensive as a hotel stay—but that doesn’t mean you should count this type of vacation stay out.

With coupon codes and offers that’ll drop the price on family-friendly homes, lodges for large group trips, and tiny homes made for solo travelers, there are plenty of ways to save. Vrbo rarely offers traditional promo codes though, so it’s key to take advantage of coupons and the following saving hacks if you want to book for less.
Save up to 30% with Vrbo discounts and coupon codes

One of the best perks of booking your accommodation through Vrbo is the greater flexibility—and comfort—when it comes to the duration of your stay. There are major discount benefits if you time it right, plus up to 30% off with coupons for specific properties. Vrbo rarely releases sitewide coupon codes; however, they offer discounts on early bookings (on reservations over 60 days in advance), last-minute deals (if you book within 30 days of check-in), and extended stays of 7 nights or more.

From a beachy Hamptons getaway to a Parisian apartment near the Eiffel Tower, Vrbo makes it easy to save big on spots across the world. Headed to the Poconos for a foliage-friendly getaway? You can score 47% off this new chalet when you book early for a Novermber trip. Individual Vrbo listings can have bonus discounts offered by the host, such as mid-week specials, and up to 30% off rates during the location's off-season months.
Vrbo discounts for military personnel, educators, first responders & others

While Vrbo doesn’t offer site-wide fixed discounts for military personnel, educators, or first responders, since prices are set by the hosts, individual hosts can choose to offer their properties at a discount on an ad hoc basis. One example is this seven-bedroom mountain home—nestled into the Smoky Mountains with breathtaking panoramic views—that offers a 10% discount to those who serve in the military, educators, first responders, and church groups.
https://media.cntraveler.com/photos/631f66789855579fc3358875/1:1/w_90%2Cc_limit/PW%2520Headshot.jpg

Those who are able to verify their military status with ID.me can also take advantage of up to 5% cashback on purchases made on Vrbo. This offer is not valid on bookings that are declined or cancelled. Nurses, first responders, teachers, government employees, and students are all also eligible for up to 5% cash back. Just be sure to confirm your eligibility on ID.me before you book!
Save $275 on average on one week and $845 off monthly rentals

Sometimes, a quick weekend getaway just isn’t enough. Perhaps you’re looking for a full recharge and the chance to fully immerse yourself in a new environment without the full responsibility—and price tag—that homeownership would bring. Use Vrbo coupons and enjoy 10% off seven (or more) night stays. Easily view these deals by filtering for “Weekly discount”, and expect to save an average of $275. Head to New York for a fall trip and save $478 off a weekly stay at this luxury apartment.

Rates on month-long rentals are even better; save an average of 19% off vacation rentals when you book a stay of 28 days or more—that's an average discount of $845. To find homes that offer this discount in your destination of choice, select the “Monthly discount” filter on the search results page and enter travel dates of 28+ nights to see prices and savings. This gorgeous two-bedroom Parisian apartment is offering savings of $4,277 on monthly stays.
Get 10% off plus OneKeyCash with OneKey Rewards

Travelers can create a free Vrbo account to earn up to 10% off bookings with sign-up. After each trip, travelers will earn OneKeyCash to use on future hotel stays and car rentals booked through Vrbo, but also Expedia and Hotels.com, since the brands share the same rewards program. Members receive 2% in OneKeyCash for every dollar spent on eligible hotels, vacation rentals, activities, packages, car rentals, and cruises, and 0.2% in OneKeyCash for every dollar spent on eligible flights. While it’s not technically a Vrbo coupon code, OneKey rewards are the next closest thing if you want a discount when you book.
Score up to $350 in OneKeyCash with Vrbo’s OneKey Mastercard offer
https://media.cntraveler.com/photos/655645f48a43a61dbf5152d4/1:1/w_90%2Cc_limit/IMG_7445.jpg

While the OneKey rewards program doesn't require a credit card to join, OneKey Mastercard credit card holders have a fast track to discounts and higher OneKeyCash earning potential. They also get unique benefits like travel insurance, TSA PreCheck credits, cell phone protection, and annual bonuses. Current welcome offers grant OneKey cardholders $250 back when they spend $1,000 in the first three months, while OneKey+ cardholders (which has an $99 annual fee) get $350 in cash rewards when they spend $3,000 in the first three months.

As for earnings potential, all OneKey and OneKey+ cardholders earn 3% on Vrbo bookings made with their card (as well as Expedia and Hotels.com reservations); silver members earn an additional 1% and gold members earn an additional 2%, meaning savings of up to 5% for continued booking loyalty. Since OneKey cardholders get automatic silver tier in the OneKey rewards program and OneKey+ gets gold tier, you're already ahead of the curve when it comes to savings.

For purchases at gas stations, grocery stores, and dining, both cardholders get 3% in OneKeyCash; for all other purchases, OneKey+ cardholders earn 2% and OneKey 1.5%. Another perk for OneKey+ cardholders: $100 in OneKeyCash every year, awarded on the anniversary of the account open date.
Book a new Vrbo rental, get up to 40% off your stay without a promo code

Vrbo unveils fresh listings daily, often offering substantial savings for those quick enough to seize the opportunity. If you’re among the first three guests to book a newly listed property (or one added in the last 90 days), you can enjoy up to 25% off your stay. Right now, we're seeing discounts all over the map—in London, Punta Cana, Miami, Las Vegas, and more. Book this new apartment in Barcelona's Sarrià-Sant Gervasi neighborhood, for instance, and get $276 off a weekly stay.
How to fix a Vrbo coupon code that’s not working

If your Vrbo coupon code isn't working, be sure to check for typos, extra spaces, or incorrect capitalization, as well as any terms and conditions. You can also try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers. When all else fails, Vrbo's Help Center is there to steer you the right way.
